title: One Waveform, Two Stories: Benchmarking Speech-Acoustic Conflict in Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.00325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-language models (ALMs) are evaluated on their understanding of both speech and environmental sounds. What remains underexplored is how they respond when spoken claims contradict acoustic evidence within the same recording. We introduce SAC-Bench, a benchmark of intra-audio speech--acoustic conflict comprising 616,031 unique clips from 188 sound-event classes across seven semantic, temporal, and spatial tasks. It pairs environmental recordings with compatible or contradictory synthesized spoken claims and includes audio-only controls where applicable. Across five open-weight ALMs evaluated on semantic and temporal tasks, high audio-only accuracy often coexists with large losses under conflicting claims; Event Identity accuracy is 24.8--46.5 percentage points lower in conflict than compatible conditions. translated_title: 一个波形，两个故事：音频-语言模型中语音-声学冲突的基准测试
translated_abstract: 音频-语言模型（ALMs）通常在其对语音和环境声音的理解能力上进行评估。然而，尚未被充分探索的问题是：当语音陈述与同一录音中的声学证据相矛盾时，这些模型会如何反应。我们提出了SAC-Bench，这是一个针对音频内语音-声学冲突的基准测试，包含来自188个声音事件类别的616,031个独特片段，涵盖七个语义、时间和空间任务。该基准将环境录音与兼容或矛盾的合成语音陈述配对，并在适用情况下包含纯音频对照。在五个开源权重的ALMs上对语义和时间任务进行评估后发现，纯音频的高准确率往往与冲突陈述下的大幅性能下降并存；事件身份的准确率在冲突条件下比兼容条件低24.8至46.5个百分点。即使在语音跟在完整事件序列之后播放的情况下，时间顺序任务的失败仍然持续存在，因此同时的语音-事件掩码无法（解决该问题）……
tldr: 该论文提出SAC-Bench基准测试，揭示了音频-语言模型在面对同一录音中语音陈述与声学证据相互矛盾时的脆弱性——事件识别准确率下降24.8至46.5个百分点，暴露出模型缺乏处理音频内语音-声学冲突的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SAC-Bench, revealing that audio-language models suffer severe performance drops (24.8–46.5 percentage points in Event Identity accuracy) when spoken claims contradict acoustic evidence within the same recording, exposing their inability to handle intra-audio speech-acoustic conflicts.
